_about: Public-domain William Warburton (1698-1779), Bishop of Gloucester and controversialist, for the Word Hoard: The Divine Legation of Moses Demonstrated in its first printing (vol. I, 1738; vol. II part 1, 1741) and his Works in Hurd's seven-volume quarto edition (1788), from Internet Archive scans. His editions of Pope and Shakespeare are other men's works and are not shelved. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 34 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
